summary: Full end-to-end testing of Kortkväll (Swedish card-game app). Backend: 19/19 pytest cases green after fixing 3 ObjectId serialization bugs. Frontend: complete flow works — login (admin), 3-step Ny match (players → rules+custom rule → placements), Elo badges on match detail, comments (text + emoji), Historik, Topplista with sort, Regler (with delete), Patch-notes add, search filter, logout, protected-route redirect, wrong-password Swedish error. Fixed 3 additional React useEffect bugs that crashed Rules & PatchNotes pages ('destroy is not a function').

issues: React warning: 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (Login)'. Likely calling navigate() or setState during render (e.g. inside body of Login when user is already authenticated). Non-blocking but should be moved into useEffect.

action_items: Fix setState-in-render warning in /app/frontend/src/pages/Login.jsx (wrap the auto-redirect in a useEffect instead of calling <Navigate/> or navigate() during render).
critical_code_review_comments: Bug (FIXED by tester): POST /api/rules, POST /api/matches/{id}/comments and POST /api/patch-notes returned 500 because motor's insert_one mutates the passed dict adding an ObjectId `_id`, which FastAPI cannot serialize. Fixed by doc.pop('_id', None) before returning.

Bug (FIXED by tester): Rules.jsx, PatchNotes.jsx and MatchDetail.jsx used `useEffect(load, [])` where `load` returns a Promise. React tried to invoke the Promise as a cleanup function producing 'destroy is not a function' runtime error, breaking the whole page. Wrapped calls in `useEffect(() => { load(); }, [...])`.
Enhancement: consider a shared error boundary at the ProtectedLayout level so a single component failure doesn't blank the entire screen.
Enhancement: /api/leaderboard sorting is done server-side by rating only; the frontend Topplista supports column sort — verified working, but confirm large-dataset sort is consistent.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all core flows pass; one non-blocking React warning on Login)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 19 cases covering auth, users, positions, rules CRUD, matches with Elo delta validation, comments, patch-notes). Routes are Swedish: /regler, /historik, /topplista, /patchnotes. Ensure `useEffect(load, [])` pattern isn't reintroduced. Emergent Google OAuth external flow was not exercised — only the JWT email/password flow was tested end-to-end.
rca_of_the_issue: Two classes of bugs found and fixed: (1) MongoDB inserted docs were returned directly, exposing non-serializable ObjectId _id → 500. (2) useEffect(load) where load returns a Promise caused React to call the promise as a cleanup fn on unmount → 'destroy is not a function' runtime error breaking Rules & PatchNotes screens.
